name: Multi-window routing
description: Verify deterministic addressing, task routing, movement, and aggregation across native Cmux windows.

variants.description: Create frontend, backend, and ops windows with deterministic workers in a dedicated visible session.
setup: Capture the baseline window tree and prepare three deterministic task fixtures labeled frontend, backend, and ops.
Create a run ownership ledger before opening any native window.
exercise: Create three run-owned windows, place the matching workspace and worker in each, and dispatch tasks using explicit window and surface refs.
Move one owned workspace between two owned windows, prove its stable identity survives, restore it, and aggregate all three results.

assertions.expectation: Exactly three owned windows exist and each contains the expected labeled workspace and surface.
Each deterministic worker receives only the task matching its window role and returns a correlated artifact.
Moving the owned workspace changes its parent window while preserving its stable workspace identity.
The aggregate contains one evidence-backed result from frontend, backend, and ops.
All windows created by the run close and every pre-existing window remains unchanged.

cleanup: Stop deterministic workers and close owned workspaces before closing their owned native windows.
Compare the remaining window tree with the exact baseline and remove fixture artifacts.
